To sign in with your YouTube Music account on desktop:
1. Open music.youtube.com in your browser with the button below and sign in.
2. Press F12 and open Developer Tools → Network.
3. Reload the page and click a 'browse' or 'music.youtube.com' request.
4. Under Request Headers, copy the 'Cookie' value and paste it below.
Open YouTube Music in the browser

Lindale is a desktop port of Metrolist. The YouTube Music side is the work of the Metrolist team below; thank you!
Lindale\'s window shows up black in screenshots, recordings and screen sharing (Discord, Teams, OBS).
Colors follow the album art of the song that is playing.
Click a lyrics line to jump to that part of the song.
Keeps the current line in view while the song plays.
Shown at the top of Library > Playlists.
An ad-free YouTube Music player for Windows. Search, play, download songs and keep your library in sync. These steps take a minute and you can skip any of them.
Sign in with your Google account to get your YouTube Music library, liked songs, playlists and history. Lindale also works without an account.

1. Open Exportify, log in with Spotify and export a playlist (or all of them) as a CSV file. 2. Open the import screen here and choose \"Import a CSV playlist\". Lindale finds each song on YouTube Music and makes a playlist.
M3U playlists from other players (foobar2000, VLC, iTunes) work the same way.

Ctrl+K: search Space: play / pause Ctrl+← / →: previous / next song Ctrl+↑ / ↓: volume Shift+← / →: seek 5 seconds Ctrl+S: shuffle · Ctrl+R: repeat · Ctrl+M: mute
Your keyboard\'s media keys and the Windows media panel (next to the volume popup) also control Lindale.
Also restores backups made with Metrolist on Android.
Opens Exportify. Log in with Spotify, download a playlist as CSV, then use \"Import a CSV playlist\" below.

Spotify (Exportify), TuneMyMusic, Soundiiz or any CSV with title and artist columns. Each song is matched on YouTube Music.
